analysis.reason: 5일 연속 상승 후 눌림 구간 진입. RSI는 60선에서 중립 유지, MACD 히스토그램은 개선되고 있으나 여전히 음수권으로 약세 수렴 중. 5일 평균 대비 거래량 비율 1.68로 급증했으나, 현재가($56.68)가 스윙 저항선($56.94)에 근접하여 추가 상승보다는 관망이 합리적.
analysis.reasonEn: Entered a pullback phase after 5 consecutive days of gains. RSI remains neutral around 60, and MACD histogram is improving but still in negative territory, indicating weak convergence. Volume ratio at 1.68 (surge) suggests activity, but the current price ($56.68) is near the swing resistance ($56.94), making observation more prudent than aggressive buying.

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (-0.0632→-0.0299) — 음수권에서 개선되며 약세 수렴 지속
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치(중단 $56.11) — 중단선 부근 횡보

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($56.68) vs SMA5/20/50 ($56.66/$56.11/$53.89) — Above SMA5, SMA20, and SMA50, confirming short-to-mid-term uptrend.
· Above SMA100/200 ($52.15/$52.44) by over 8% — Mid-to-long-term trend strength maintained.
· 52-week position (90.7%) — Located near historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (62.6→60.9) — Cooling from overbought territory, staying neutral.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-0.0632→-0.0299) — Improving in negative territory, continuing weak convergence.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Middle Band $56.11) — Trading around the middle band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($54.34) — Based on 5-day low ($55.45) and Pivot S1 ($54.42).
· Swing Resistance ($56.94) — Based on 5-day high ($57.60) and Pivot R1 ($58.27); potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day High ($57.60) / 5-day Low ($55.45), 20-day High ($57.60) / 20-day Low ($53.75) — Pullback from 5-day high, rise from 20-day low, entering range-bound trading.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.68x) — Surge compared to 5-day average, increasing confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis — Pullback within an uptrend; conditions met for observation near swing resistance.
